Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
Prep 10 minutes, cook 12 minutes.

- 400 g beef sirloin, thinly sliced
- 300 g broccoli florets
- 3 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp oyster sauce
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp grated ginger

1. Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce and cornstarch.
2. Stir-fry the beef in hot sesame oil for 3 minutes, then remove it.
3. Stir-fry the broccoli and ginger for 4 minutes.
4. Return the beef, add the sauce and cook until glossy.
